description: For \(T\supseteq Q\) and a fixed unary arithmetic formula satisfying D1–D3, \(T\vdash\Box A\to A\) if and only if \(T\vdash A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Lob.reflection_iff {T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory}
  {P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula Unit}
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Lob.DerivabilityConditions T P)
  (hQ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q ⊆ T)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T
      (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.imp (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Lob.box P A) A) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A
